title: Editor
description: Edit storefront content, visuals, and theme settings in a live preview.

empty.title: Choose a storefront template first
empty.description: Select a storefront template before editing copy, images, logo, and theme settings.

actions.resetDescription: This resets the editor to the draft that was loaded when you opened this page.
actions.publishDescription: Review your shop before making this design live.
actions.publishWithFallbacks: {count} Amharic fields will use their English text. You can publish now and translate them later.
actions.pauseDescription: Customers will see that the store is unavailable. Your draft stays saved so you can publish again anytime.
actions.leaveDescription: You have unsaved editor changes. If you leave now, those changes will be lost.

toast.launchNotReady: Finish the required steps in the setup guide, then review and publish your shop.
toast.launchCheckUnavailable: We couldn’t check your shop right now. Please try again shortly.
toast.reset: Editor reset to the last loaded draft.
toast.imageImportFailed: Could not import this image. Try again.
toast.imageTooLarge: Images must be 15 MB or smaller.
toast.imageUploadFailed: Could not upload this image. Try again.

shell.title: Storefront editor
shell.hint: Click outlined text in the preview, or refine details in settings.
shell.hintPaused: Shop is paused for customers. Edit freely, then publish when you are ready.

settings.sharedContactHelp: Your contact details and shop description are shared across your storefront. Update them once in Shop settings.
settings.description: Links, images, colors, and fallback content.

theme.appearanceHelp: Surface and brand color drive a full palette with readable contrast. Accent stays related to your brand. Edit any swatch for full control. Open the menu for rebuild or reset to defaults.
theme.autoPaletteOn: Brand and surface keep the set in sync.
theme.autoPaletteOff: Manual colors. Rebuild from brand anytime.
theme.heading: Heading

media.uploadOrChoose: Upload a file or choose from your library

merchandising.emptySelectionHint: Empty selection shows newest products on the storefront.
merchandising.manualSelectionHint: Only these products appear in this section.
merchandising.featuredProductsDescription: Pick products for this section, or clear selection to show newest products on the storefront.
merchandising.noManualPick: No manual selection. The live shop shows the newest products.

translations.title: Translations
translations.description: Manage the languages customers see across your storefront.
translations.needsReviewDescription: Some of this item is translated and some still uses English. Open it to finish or choose English intentionally.
translations.catalogIncomplete: Some fields still use English. Translate them or choose Use English.
translations.sourceChanged: The English text changed. Check that this still says what you want.
translations.readyDescription: The Amharic translation matches the current English source.
translations.usingEnglishDescription: No Amharic translation is saved yet, so customers see the English text.
translations.coverageHelpSummary: See what each coverage color means.
translations.saveFailed: Translations could not be saved. Try again.
translations.empty: No page text matches this view.
translations.disabledDescription: Enable Amharic in Storefront settings before adding translations.
translations.loadError: Storefront translations could not be loaded.
translations.shopPagesDescription: Homepage, navigation, footer, contact details, and search preview.
translations.productsDescription: Translate products and the groups customers browse.
translations.customerExperienceDescription: Cart, checkout, account, orders, and search controls are maintained with the storefront.
translations.catalogQueueDescription: Continue items that still need attention. Open the full list to work through a larger catalog.
translations.searchPreviewDescription: This is how your Amharic shop title and description may appear in search results.
